verdict.rationale: The Intel Core Ultra 9 285K is a desktop CPU, a hardware component. User-defined rules that trigger actions on events are a software automation-platform capability, so this axis is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows the processor itself shipping such a rules engine: the AI-engine, oneAPI and vPro items describe compute and tooling, not event-triggered automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
